thread:
maya: Heads-up: launching a short SI FieldPlay onramp (pilot cohort) — goal is a 2-day hands-on that covers marketplace listing, model deploy in sandbox, basic perf checks, and badge issuance. Need owners for: lab ops, listing dry-run, and partner office hours. Who’s in?

samir: I can take lab ops + voucher ops. Need to confirm H100 vs Arm availability with partners. Also will produce a 1-page ops checklist (CIDR, KMS, IAM role).

lena: I’ll own the curriculum + assessment flow. Thinking: Day1 = listing + deploy, Day2 = perf + incident drill. Will draft module timing.

danielle: Marketplace dry-run + video demo I’ll do. Will include step-by-step shell commands and a rollback example.

harry: I can coordinate partner office hours and on-call windows. Will ask RackScale/CloudWave for 24h fallback for first 48h.

partners-bot: Reminder: create event "SI FieldPlay pilot" 11:00 PT next Wed. Event scheduled.

maya: Constraints: ephemeral creds only, no prod keys, consent checkbox for data retention, and clear badge revocation rules (e.g., if partner breaks listing policy). Add these to the playbook.

samir: Voucher plan: 15 single-day and 5 extended. Quick sample API for ops provisioning: 
```
POST /internal/vouchers {"type":"single-day","count":15}
```
Will post codes when provisioned.

lena: Assessment split: quick quiz (20%), lab practical (60%), roleplay incident (20%). Pass = 75%. Need two graders for pilot. Danielle + Harry ok?

danielle: Yup can grade lab practicals.

harry: Ok to help with roleplay grading.

maya: Action items: Samir = ops checklist + vouchers (Mon EOD), Lena = curriculum + grader list (Mon), Danielle = dry-run video + rollback script (Tue), Harry = partner office hours contacts (Tue). Reconvene Tue for preflight.

partners-bot: Reaction logged: :rocket: kickoff created.

lena: Quick Q: do we want partners to surface sample metrics (p50/p95) per model variant for lab? Would help set perf targets.

maya: Yes — ask partners to provide baseline perf for any partner-provided hardware. Put it in the preflight doc.

samir: Noted. Will collect baselines and paste here.

danielle: Also adding a tiny troubleshooting card for common issues: token expiry, ECR perms, VPC route. Keeps the floor lean.

maya: Thanks team. Excited to run FieldPlay. :tada:
